headline: GM3 Retires
caption:
Gerald Meerschaert walked away after 60 pro fights, holding a record Anderson Silva doesn't.
Legend or not? 👇

After Julius Walker stopped him at UFC Vegas 122, the 38-year-old retired in the Octagon at 37-23. His 12 finishes are the most in UFC middleweight history, one more than Silva. MMA news.

Best GM3 moment?
question: Legend or not?
